role.zh: Runway 联合创始人兼联席 CEO

why.en: First to push generative video into real film-industry production pipelines. The Gen line defined the early standard for AI video — and he now argues that video was only the prequel to world models.
why.zh: 最早把生成式视频推向影视工业实际生产流程，Gen 系列模型定义了 AI 视频的早期标准 —— 他现在主张视频只是世界模型的前传。

title.en: AI video is just the prequel to world models
title.zh: AI 视频只是世界模型的前传

title.en: Today we're announcing that the team from Kinetix is joining Runway. Their work on 3D human motion and physically grounded video generation will help advance ou
title.zh: Today we're announcing that the team from Kinetix is joining Runway. Their work on 3D human motion and physically grounded video generation will help advance ou

note.en: Runway is acquiring the team from Kinetix, whose work on 3D human motion will feed into Runway's world-model research for robotics.
note.zh: Runway收购了Kinetix团队，其在3D人体动作方面的研究成果将用于Runway面向机器人的世界模型研究。

title.en: Runway is now in Adobe.
title.zh: Runway is now in Adobe.

note.en: Valenzuela announces that Runway is now integrated into Adobe.
note.zh: Valenzuela宣布Runway现已接入Adobe。

title.en: In the last 10 days, we announced Solaris, GWM 2 Worlds, the new Teams plan, Runway Dev MCP, Runway Ruby and the world went crazy playing HORSE. We also launche
title.zh: In the last 10 days, we announced Solaris, GWM 2 Worlds, the new Teams plan, Runway Dev MCP, Runway Ruby and the world went crazy playing HORSE. We also launche

note.en: Valenzuela recapped Runway's last 10 days: launches of Solaris, GWM 2 Worlds, a new Teams plan, Runway Dev MCP, Runway Ruby, and traction for the 10-week-old Runway Agent.
note.zh: Valenzuela总结了Runway过去10天的进展：发布了Solaris、GWM 2 Worlds、新的Teams方案、Runway Dev MCP、Runway Ruby，以及上线10周的Runway Agent的使用情况。

title.en: Solaris is an interface world model: an interactive, real-time video model that can create and render an interface for you. But most importantly, Solaris has th
title.zh: Solaris is an interface world model: an interactive, real-time video model that can create and render an interface for you. But most importantly, Solaris has th

note.en: Valenzuela introduced Solaris, an interactive real-time video model that can generate and render interfaces on the fly.
note.zh: 巴伦苏埃拉发布了Solaris，这是一款可以实时生成并渲染界面的交互式视频模型。

title.en: We have normalized magic. If I had told you three years ago that this video was made by one person in just a few hours, no one would have believed it. Now it’s
title.zh: We have normalized magic. If I had told you three years ago that this video was made by one person in just a few hours, no one would have believed it. Now it’s

note.en: Reflected on how AI-generated video, once astonishing, has become the new normal — a single person can now make in hours what once seemed impossible.
note.zh: 感慨AI生成视频曾令人惊叹，如今已成为新常态——一个人几小时内就能完成过去难以想象的作品。

title.en: A small but meaningful QoL update, and perhaps one of the most requested features in Runway. We now power close to 90% of the Fortune 500 with enterprise-ready
title.zh: A small but meaningful QoL update, and perhaps one of the most requested features in Runway. We now power close to 90% of the Fortune 500 with enterprise-ready

note.en: Announced a requested Team Plan update and said Runway now powers enterprise deployments for close to 90% of the Fortune 500.
note.zh: 宣布了备受期待的Team Plan更新，并表示Runway目前已为近90%的财富500强企业提供企业级部署支持。

title.en: The preview releases of Solaris and GWM 2 Worlds this week are just a glimpse of what happens when video world models are scaled significantly and paired with r
title.zh: The preview releases of Solaris and GWM 2 Worlds this week are just a glimpse of what happens when video world models are scaled significantly and paired with r

note.en: Framed the preview releases of Solaris and GWM 2 Worlds as an early glimpse of real-time, richly simulated video world models paired with reasoning.
note.zh: 他将Solaris和GWM 2 Worlds的预览版视为实时、高保真视频世界模型与推理能力结合的早期展示。

title.en: It's been so fun watching what GWM Worlds 2 can do. This model makes high-fidelity video and audio generation into real-time interactive simulation. Here are so
title.zh: It's been so fun watching what GWM Worlds 2 can do. This model makes high-fidelity video and audio generation into real-time interactive simulation. Here are so

note.en: Valenzuela showcased examples from GWM Worlds 2, Runway's world model that turns prompts into high-fidelity, real-time interactive video and audio simulation.
note.zh: 巴伦苏埃拉展示了Runway世界模型GWM Worlds 2的示例，该模型能生成高保真、实时交互式的视频和音频模拟。

title.en: We are sharing a major update to our General World Models efforts. GWM Worlds 2 can generate full, interactive, real-time video simulations in one continuous 72
title.zh: We are sharing a major update to our General World Models efforts. GWM Worlds 2 can generate full, interactive, real-time video simulations in one continuous 72

note.en: Valenzuela announced a major update to Runway's General World Models line: GWM Worlds 2 generates continuous interactive real-time video at 720p/24fps with synchronized audio.
note.zh: 巴伦苏埃拉宣布Runway通用世界模型系列的重大更新：GWM Worlds 2可生成720p、24fps的连续交互式实时视频，并同步生成音频。

title.en: The interface is a live stream of pixels.
title.zh: The interface is a live stream of pixels.

note.en: Valenzuela describes the interface itself as 'a live stream of pixels,' a compact statement of his view that generative video points toward real-time, model-generated interfaces.
note.zh: 瓦伦苏埃拉将界面本身描述为“像素的实时流”,简明表达了他认为生成式视频将通向实时、由模型生成的界面这一观点。

title.en: Ruby can transform ANY VIDEO MODEL output to behave like native professional VFX footage. ACES is an industry-standard system for film, VFX, animation, and high
title.zh: Ruby can transform ANY VIDEO MODEL output to behave like native professional VFX footage. ACES is an industry-standard system for film, VFX, animation, and high

note.en: Valenzuela announced Runway's Ruby tool, which converts any AI video model's output into ACES-compliant footage matching professional VFX and film post-production standards.
note.zh: 瓦伦苏埃拉宣布了Runway的Ruby工具,可将任意AI视频模型的输出转换为符合ACES标准的专业影视后期制作画面。

title.en: This is a real-time interactive application. The image is the interface. The interface is a live stream of pixels. Everything is simulated as you interact with
title.zh: This is a real-time interactive application. The image is the interface. The interface is a live stream of pixels. Everything is simulated as you interact with

note.en: Valenzuela showcased a real-time interactive application where a live video stream is itself the interface, fully simulated as the user interacts with any part of the screen.
note.zh: 瓦伦苏埃拉展示了一款实时交互应用,视频画面本身即是界面,用户与屏幕任意位置互动时内容会被实时模拟生成。

title.en: Interfaces that are generated, not coded. Excited to finally share Solaris. Video is the universal interface. Eventually, all UI will be chat and gestures in, c
title.zh: Interfaces that are generated, not coded. Excited to finally share Solaris. Video is the universal interface. Eventually, all UI will be chat and gestures in, c

note.en: Valenzuela unveiled Solaris, Runway's generated (not coded) interface, framing video as the universal interface for future AI products.
note.zh: Valenzuela发布了Runway的Solaris——一种“生成而非编写代码”的界面，认为视频将成为未来AI产品的通用交互形式。

title.en: Trying to help make Chile the capital of AI in LATAM. There's so much energy potential and research talent. Sometimes I hear people say that some things can’t b
title.zh: Trying to help make Chile the capital of AI in LATAM. There's so much energy potential and research talent. Sometimes I hear people say that some things can’t b

note.en: Cristóbal Valenzuela argued Chile has the energy and research talent to become a hub for AI in Latin America.
note.zh: Cristóbal Valenzuela 提出，凭借能源与科研人才优势，智利有潜力成为拉美的 AI 中心。

title.en: Video Models, Robot Brains, and a $40M Bet on Japan | Runway CEO Cristóbal Valenzuela
title.zh: Video Models, Robot Brains, and a $40M Bet on Japan | Runway CEO Cristóbal Valenzuela

note.en: Podcast interview in which he lays out Runway's move from video generation toward world models and robotics, and the company's $40M commitment to Japan.
note.zh: 播客访谈，他阐述了 Runway 从视频生成转向世界模型与机器人的路线，以及公司对日本市场 4000 万美元的投入。

title.en: Cristóbal Valenzuela on How Runway's World Models Are Changing Storytelling
title.zh: Cristóbal Valenzuela on How Runway's World Models Are Changing Storytelling

note.en: A long-form interview tracing his route from Chile to NYU's ITP to founding Runway, and why he now frames world models rather than video generation as the company's direction.
note.zh: 一次长篇访谈，讲述他从智利到纽约大学 ITP、再到创办 Runway 的经历，以及他为何把世界模型而非视频生成视为公司的方向。

title.en: Runway CEO Cristobal Valenzuela is simulating the world
title.zh: Runway CEO Cristobal Valenzuela is simulating the world

note.en: An interview in which he argues Runway's real product is world simulation rather than video clips, and discusses what remains hardest in generative AI.
note.zh: 他在访谈中提出 Runway 真正的产品是对世界的模拟而非视频片段，并谈到生成式 AI 目前最难解决的问题。

title.en: Runway founder Cristóbal Valenzuela wants Hollywood to embrace AI
title.zh: Runway founder Cristóbal Valenzuela wants Hollywood to embrace AI

note.en: KCRW interview making his case for Hollywood to adopt generative video rather than resist it.
note.zh: KCRW 访谈，他主张好莱坞应当拥抱生成式视频，而不是抵制它。

title.en: Hollywood’s hottest AI partner, with Runway’s Cristóbal Valenzuela
title.zh: Hollywood’s hottest AI partner, with Runway’s Cristóbal Valenzuela

note.en: Interview on Runway's studio partnerships with Disney and Netflix and how generative tools are entering real film production pipelines.
note.zh: 访谈聚焦 Runway 与迪士尼、Netflix 的合作，以及生成式工具如何真正进入影视制作流程。

title.en: Ep 38: Runway CEO Cristobal Valenzuela on the Next Frontiers for AI Media and The Role of Human Taste in AI Filmmaking
title.zh: Ep 38: Runway CEO Cristobal Valenzuela on the Next Frontiers for AI Media and The Role of Human Taste in AI Filmmaking

note.en: Interview around the Gen-3 Alpha release on where AI media goes next and what role human taste still plays in filmmaking.
note.zh: 围绕 Gen-3 Alpha 发布的访谈，讨论 AI 媒体的下一步，以及人的审美判断在电影创作中仍然扮演的角色。

title.en: Generative AI in Video and the Future of Storytelling (with Runway CEO Cristobal Valenzuela)
title.zh: Generative AI in Video and the Future of Storytelling (with Runway CEO Cristobal Valenzuela)

note.en: Interview on generative video and the future of storytelling, including Runway's work on the Oscar-winning "Everything Everywhere All at Once".
note.zh: 关于生成式视频与叙事未来的访谈，其中谈到 Runway 参与奥斯卡获奖影片《瞬息全宇宙》的工作。

title.en: Meet the AI company that wants to remake Hollywood
title.zh: Meet the AI company that wants to remake Hollywood

note.en: Valenzuela discussed Runway's mission to reshape Hollywood with AI video tools, as a guest on Channels with Peter Kafka.
note.zh: Valenzuela做客Peter Kafka的Channels播客,谈论Runway用AI视频工具重塑好莱坞的愿景。

title.en: Building the future of VFX and video editing with Runway CEO Cristóbal Valenzuela | E1724
title.zh: Building the future of VFX and video editing with Runway CEO Cristóbal Valenzuela | E1724

note.en: Long-form interview on Runway's generative video editing tools, its AI Film Festival, and how filmmaking workflows are changing.
note.zh: 长篇访谈，谈 Runway 的生成式视频编辑工具、AI 电影节，以及电影制作流程正在发生的变化。

title.en: Mental models and next gen AI tools with Cristóbal Valenzuela (Runway)
title.zh: Mental models and next gen AI tools with Cristóbal Valenzuela (Runway)

note.en: Interview on the mental models behind Runway's creative suite and how the company decides what an AI tool for artists should do.
note.zh: 访谈探讨 Runway 创作套件背后的思维模型，以及公司如何判断一款面向艺术家的 AI 工具应该做什么。

title.en: What does AI-powered content creation look like? with Runway ML’s Cristobal Valenzuela
title.zh: What does AI-powered content creation look like? with Runway ML’s Cristobal Valenzuela

note.en: An early interview on the point at which AI content generation became useful to professional creators rather than a novelty.
note.zh: 一次早期访谈，讨论 AI 内容生成从新奇玩具转变为专业创作者可用工具的临界点。

title.en: The Logik Podcast #26: Cristóbal Valenzuela from RunwayML
title.zh: The Logik Podcast #26: Cristóbal Valenzuela from RunwayML

note.en: An early interview on his own path, the founding of RunwayML and where machine learning was heading in visual effects.
note.zh: 一次早期访谈，讲述他的个人经历、RunwayML 的创立过程，以及机器学习在视觉特效领域的走向。

title.en: Soundify: Matching Sound Effects to Video
title.zh: Soundify: Matching Sound Effects to Video

note.en: A Runway paper, co-authored with CTO Anastasis Germanidis, on automatically matching sound effects to video for editors — his own research output rather than a namesake's.
note.zh: 他与 Runway 首席技术官 Anastasis Germanidis 合著的论文，研究如何为视频自动匹配音效以辅助剪辑，确属他本人的研究成果。

title.en: Cristóbal Valenzuela (Runway)
title.zh: Cristóbal Valenzuela (Runway)

note.en: A Spanish-language interview with the Chilean show TODO POR LA TARDE on founding Runway and using machine learning to extend what creators can make.
note.zh: 接受智利节目 TODO POR LA TARDE 的西班牙语访谈，谈创办 Runway 以及用机器学习拓展创作者的能力边界。

title.en: $315M Series E at a $5.3B valuation
title.zh: 3.15 亿美元 E 轮，估值 53 亿美元

body.en: Led by General Atlantic, with NVIDIA, Fidelity, AllianceBernstein and Mirae. Total raised $860M. Global hubs planned for London, Tokyo and Paris backed by nearly $300M of growth investment through 2028.
body.zh: General Atlantic 领投，NVIDIA、Fidelity、AllianceBernstein 与未来资产参与。累计融资 8.6 亿美元。计划在伦敦、东京、巴黎设立中心，至 2028 年投入近 3 亿美元。
